QuestInfo.name: An Old Ill-Fated Relationship of Herb Town
QuestInfo.parent: Shadow Ghost of the Herb Town
QuestInfo.1:
Mr. Ku says the shadow ghost is actually the #bBamboo Warrior#k, who was kicked out for disturbing the town a long time ago. Defeat the Bamboo Warrior, who appears in #b60-Year-Old Herb Garden#k and report to Mr. Ku.



#o6090002# #a38521#
QuestInfo.2: You have defeated the Bamboo Warrior and reported to Mr. Ku.

0.0: I'm going to need your help one more time. It won't be easy... but will you help?

yes.0: Thanks so much for agreeing to help. Upon examining the Ripped Scroll Pieces you brought me, my findings suggest that the shadow ghost is the #bBamboo Warrior#k.
yes.1: The #bBamboo Warrior#k used to disturb Herb Town, and the town residents eventually drove him out. They assumed that he had disappeared for good, but who knew he'd turn into a monster and come back for revenge? Please, defeat the Bamboo Warrior. We'd like to be rid of this nuisance once and for all.
yes.2: According to those who witnessed the appearance of the Bamboo Warrior, he mostly appears in the #b60-Year-Old Herb Garden#k. You can go alone if you'd like, but I recommend you forming a party. I hear he's quite formidable.

no.0: I understand. It is a challenge. Come again if you change your mind.

1.0: You must have eliminated the Bamboo Warrior already. I'll tell the town residents they are free to gather herbs. Thank you.

yes.0: The Bamboo Warrior's reign of terror ends here...

mob.0: You haven't eliminated the Bamboo Warrior yet, eh? Please, I ask you on behalf of everyone in Herb Town. Form a party, and face him!
